repo.ISSUE.md: label_invoices gives me the lookup, but `lines` is always empty. I expected one line per invoice.

fix.code:
def label_invoices(names, invoices):
    """Return (lookup, lines): a name -> due dict and one 'name: due' line per invoice."""
    pairs = list(zip(names, (x.due for x in invoices)))
    lookup = dict(pairs)
    lines = ["%s: %s" % (name, value) for name, value in pairs]
    return lookup, lines
